==Biography==
===2015 Season===
Han "'''Peanut'''" Wang-ho joined the Najin organization in late 2014 but was only announced as an official sub for [[NaJin e-mFire]] later in December. He finally turned 17 in February and played in his first competitive match at [[SBENU Champions Spring 2015]] against [[SK Telecom T1]] later that month. He shared the starting jungle position with [[Watch]] for the rest of the tournament, where NaJin finished 6th overall. NaJin placed fifth in the regular season of [[SBENU Champions Summer 2015]] and qualified for the playoffs but they lost in the first round 2-1 to the [[KOO Tigers]]. However, Peanut did not play in any of these games. They earned enough circuit points to make it to the [[2015 Season Korea Regional Finals]] but lost 3-0 in the first round to the [[Jin Air Green Wings]].

===2016 Preseason===
NaJin played in the [[2015 LoL KeSPA Cup]] where they lost 2-1 to [[Rebels Anarchy]] in the first round. Peanut left NaJin in December and joined [[ROX Tigers]] in January.

===2016 Season===
During the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Season|2016 LCK Spring Split]], the ROX Tigers dominated domestically in similar fashion to 2015. They finished the regular season with a 16-2 match record, losing only to [[KT Rolster]] and [[Samsung Galaxy]]. Earning first place in the regular season gave them a bye to the finals of the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Playoffs|Spring Playoffs]], where they faced [[SK Telecom T1]]. ROX entered as the favorites this time, but still lost 3-1, earning themselves second place for the spring split.

During the [[LCK/2016 Season/Summer Season|2016 LCK Summer Split]], the Tigers once again placed first in the regular season with an impressive 15-3 scoreline in Bo3s, with two losses to [[SK Telecom T1]] and one loss to [[Samsung Galaxy]]. This seeded them in the [[LCK/2016 Season/Summer Playoffs|2016 LCK Summer Playoffs]] directly into their third domestic finals, where they eventually met [[KT Rolster]]. In an epic series, the ROX Tigers won the set 3-2, claiming 1st place in the Summer Split and giving them Korea's first seed into the [[2016 Season World Championship]].

At the [[2016 Season World Championship]], the ROX Tigers were placed into Group A, along with [[G2 Esports]], [[Counter Logic Gaming]], and [[Albus NoX Luna]].

== Trivia ==
* Changed his legal name from Yoon Wang-ho (윤왕호) to Han Wang-ho (한왕호) in April 2016.
* Originally known for his {{ci|Olaf}}, {{ci|Nidalee}}, and {{ci|Elise}}.
** He went 11/0/6 on {{ci|Olaf}} during a match against [[SK Telecom T1]] during the [[LCK/2018 Season/Spring Season|LCK 2018 Spring Season]].
* His mother owns a restaurant in the Chang-dong neighborhood of Seoul which is decorated with posters and other memorabilia of him. 

=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on June 24, 2021.
** Was the 14th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], and [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun) | Ghost]].
** His 1000th kill was on [[T1]]'s Support [[Keria]] in the [[LCK 2021 Summer|LCK 2021 Summer Season]] with {{ci|Diana}}.
** Was the 3rd Jungler to reach 1000 kills after [[Score]] and [[Ambition]].
* Reached 1500 kills in the LCK on April 9th, 2023.
** Was the 11th player to reach 1500 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], and [[Chovy]].
** His 1500th kill was on [[T1]]'s Top-Laner [[Zeus]] in the [[LCK 2023 Spring Playoffs|LCK 2023 Spring Playoffs]] with {{ci|Wukong}}.
** Was the 2nd Jungler to reach 1500 kills after [[Score]].
* Reached 2000 kills in the LCK on July 26th, 2025.
** Was the 9th player to reach 2000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], [[Aiming]], and [[ShowMaker]].
** His 2000th kill was on [[KT Rolster]]'s Bot-Laner [[deokdam]] in the [[LCK 2025 Rounds 3-5|LCK 2025 Rounds 3-5]] with {{ci|Wukong}}.
** Was the 1st Jungler to reach 2000 kills.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on July 22nd, 2022.
** Was the 7th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan) | Wolf]], [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[TusiN]], and [[Deft]].
* Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on August 20th, 2023.
** Was the 4th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Faker]], and [[Lehends]].
* Reached 5000 assists in the LCK on April 9th, 2025.
** Was the 3rd player to reach 5000 assists in the LCK after [[Faker]] and [[Lehends]].
* Reached 300 wins in LCK on June 24th, 2022, becoming the 7th player to do so after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[GorillA]], [[Deft]], and [[Ruler]].
* Reached 400 wins in LCK on July 26th, 2023, becoming the 3rd player to do so after [[Faker]] and [[Deft]].
* Reached 500 wins in LCK on April 17th, 2025, becoming the 2nd player to do so after [[Faker]].
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on July 24th, 2022, becoming the 7th player to do so, after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[Ruler]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], and [[Teddy]].
* Reached 600 games in the LCK on July 2nd, 2023, becoming the 4th player to do so, after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], and [[Bdd]].
* Reached 700 games in the LCK on June 29th, 2024, becoming the 4th player to do so, after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], and [[Bdd]].
* Reached 800 games in the LCK on August 17th, 2025, becoming the 4th player to do so, after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], and [[Bdd]].
* Reached 1000 international assists during [[Worlds 2025 Main Event|Worlds 2025]] on October 18, 2025 in Round 3 of Swiss Stage against [[100 Thieves]], becoming the 10th player to achieve this milestone after [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[Faker]], [[xiaohu]], [[meiko]], [[Keria]], [[Caps]], [[Canyon]], [[Oner]], and [[ON]].
